in_marathi.name: Saathvika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Saathvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Saath', meaning truth, and 'Vika', meaning speaker. Saathvika represents a truth speaker or a person who speaks the truth.

vedic_reference.note: The name Saathvika is derived from the Sanskrit language and is composed of two roots: Sattva (goodness) and Anushta (devoted) or Anugrahaarh (grace-giving). It signifies one who is devoted to the principles of goodness and bestows grace upon others.
